description.en: Multi-channel account health alerts and daily AI Proxy operational digests.
description.zh: 多渠道推送账号健康告警与 AI Proxy 每日运营摘要。

docs.en: Choose a webhook type and configure its HTTPS webhook. Telegram uses the bot token and chat ID instead. The host HTTP allowlist remains authoritative.
docs.zh: 选择 Webhook 类型并配置 HTTPS 地址；Telegram 改用机器人 Token 与 Chat ID。宿主 HTTP 白名单始终生效。

help.en: Required for every type except Telegram.
help.zh: 除 Telegram 外均需填写。
填写 0 到 1 之间的小数。

help.en: HH:MM in the server timezone; keep the job override aligned when changing it.
help.zh: 服务器时区的 HH:MM；修改时请同步调整任务调度。
